title: Agent OS reference adapter and ecosystem contract gate

requirements.statement: Agent OS reference adapter is registered in the canonical TSIC adapter registry.
Agent OS owns workspace, environment, lifecycle, orchestration, UX, builder, and fleet concerns without becoming the execution authority.
Agent OS preserves tenant and execution context across workspace and workflow boundaries.
Workflow retries preserve idempotency metadata and never bypass Platform authorization.
Agent OS preserves trace and correlation context across lifecycle transitions.
The OS CI gate validates the immutable TSIC adapter contract.
